text:
alex: seeing a KV miss spike for eu traffic after yesterday's release. creating emergency hotfix v2.3.10 to disable the new cache path. target window 03:00-03:30 UTC. requesting expedited approval to skip canary — customers are hitting errors now. details: https://confluence/release/v2.3.10 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks OK (unit+smoke). Canary-skip requires 2 approvers with release:approve, one approver must be oncall.
maya: i'm oncall and can monitor. +1 from me if SRE confirms we can toggle flag instantly and pin if needed. :thumbsup:
leo: +1 from SRE with a hard constraint: rollout only if the feature-flag gating is applied per-pod and we can flip it in <30s. what's rollback plan?
alex: rollback = flip ff 'cache_v2' -> off + pin image to last-good sha xyz111. no DB work. auto-rollback triggers: sustained 4m error rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency > 2s. commands:```sh
# flip feature flag to disable cache_v2
ffctl set cache_v2 false --env=prod --region=eu
# rollback pin
kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:xyz111 -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 7070707070 --reason \"auto-rollback\"
```
sam: confirmed eu-west capacity and nodes. i'll run the probes and watch dashboards. +1.
leo: we'll gate by pod label `feature=canary` and expose ffctl toggle. i'll be ready to flip.
deploybot: Deploybot: Approval count now 3 (alex, maya, leo). Initiating gated rollout in 3m. streaming logs: https://deploylogs/7070707070
deploybot: Phase 1 (25% traffic, gated) -> OK. metrics: kv-hit-rate improving, small p50 drop.
sam: running sanity probe: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/sanity -d '{}'` -> 200
deploybot: Phase 2 (75% traffic) -> WARNING: short 30s spike in 500s observed, error-rate peaked at 1.8% then recovered to baseline. continuing with caution per approvers.
leo: spike correlated with rollout to a specific AZ. flipping ff `cache_v2` -> false on those pods to mitigate while we investigate. rollback not required yet.
maya: acknowledged, monitoring p99 and error-rate. ops team alerted and watching traces.
deploybot: Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. overall error-rate returned to <0.5% and kv-hit-rate improved ~85% vs pre-patch.
alex: added short release note for CS/support: "v2.3.10 — emergency fix disabling cache_v2 to address KV miss spike affecting EU customers; rolling 03:00-03:30 UTC; one-line note only; no schema changes." link: https://docs/releases/v2.3.10-notes
sam: good run. tagging product and support for publishing note and followup postmortem.
support: support team notified and draft note posted to the internal dashboard.
leo: we'll follow up tomorrow with an RCA on AZ-specific behavior. closing rollout. :tada:
thread_summary: Emergency hotfix v2.3.10: disabled new cache path via feature-flag gating. Expedited approvals secured (alex, maya oncall, leo SRE). Gated rollout had a brief 500 spike in Phase 2 tied to one AZ; mitigated by toggling flag on affected pods. Rollout completed, metrics improved, rollback plan (pin xyz111) ready if needed. Support notified.
